By signing this application, the applicant gives his/her:

## Consent to the Use of Personal Account

- By accepting this agreement, the User confirms full acceptance of all the provisions of the
Agreement, as well as the Rules of the Central Securities Depository, without any exception. The User also
confirms that all its actions as well as the actions of its employees (where the User is a legal entity)
authorized to share operational documents with the Central Securities Depository, are not aimed at causing
any harm to other Users;
- The User shall use a virus-checked device to receive services through a personal account;
- The Central Securities Depository shall be entitled to amend the text of the Agreement without any
specific notice to the Users;
- To receive any services of the Central Securities Depository, the User shall be identified;
- Any identified User shall have access to one or more services;
- The User shall independently ensure protection of the EDS private key against unauthorized access
and be fully responsible for the protection of the User’s EDS;
- The User shall be obliged to immediately notify the Central Securities Depository of any case of
unauthorized use of the EDS by the User;
- The User undertakes to provide the Central Securities Depository with reliable information about the
User and, where necessary, update it;
- The Central Securities Depository shall bear no responsibility for any consequences of errors in
providing information if any relevant information is missing, or any consequences of refusal to provide its
services;
- The User shall be responsible for any disclosure by the User of commercial and/or banking
information in documents received by the User from the Central Securities Depository through the personal
account.
- The content of the User's messages in exchange for messages delivered through the personal account
(“Exchange Messages”) shall not contradict the laws of the Republic of Kazakhstan, international law,
generally accepted moral standards.
- When exchanging messages, the User shall comply with the ethical standards of online
communication, in particular, shall not use profanity, insult, make false comments, or move on to topics not
related to the securities market.
- The User shall be liable for violation of these standards in accordance with the laws of the Republic
of Kazakhstan.
- Should the terms and conditions of the Agreement be violated, the Central Securities Depository shall
reserve the right to block the User's access to the personal account.
- Any potential disputes between the Central Securities Depository and the User shall be resolved
through negotiations.
